item.title: Professional Life Coach Website Overhaul
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | My immediate priority is to refresh my life-coaching website so it reflects the polished, professional image I give clients in person. The current site feels dated and clunky; I’d like it transformed into something clean, corporate and easy to navigate.
Here’s what I need from you right now: • Redesign the overall layout to look modern and executive while staying welcoming. • Rewrite or refine page copy so the value of my programmes is crystal clear and SEO-friendly. • Enhance functionality—streamlined booking, responsive design, faster load times and an intuitive blog area are must-haves.
I already have brand colours and a logo that work; you’re free to recommend subtle tweaks if they’ll strengthen the professional feel. Please build on WordPress (current host is SiteGround) so I can edit content myself later, and ensure any plug-ins are stable and lightweight.
Once we nail the website, I plan to move on to social media management and updated marketing collateral, so a holistic eye for branding is appreciated—even if our first milestone stays firmly on the site itself.
When you reply, briefly outline: 1. A similar corporate-style site you’ve completed. 2. Your proposed timeline for mock-ups, development, testing and launch. 3. How you’ll ensure fault-free migration with zero downtime.
Looking forward to collaborating on a site that truly represents the calibre of my coaching practice.

item.title: Harden WordPress Firewall & Server
item.description:
30-250 USD | My WordPress site is currently offline after malicious files were discovered on the server. I need it cleaned and brought back online, but more importantly I want to stop this from ever happening again. The immediate focus is firewall and server-side security; user authentication tweaks and data-at-rest encryption can follow once the house is no longer on fire.
There are no security plugins installed yet, so you’ll be working from a clean slate. Feel free to recommend and configure the tools you trust most—Wordfence, Sucuri, ModSecurity, Fail2Ban, or a custom stack—as long as the final setup keeps attacks out and performance intact.
Acceptance criteria • Every malicious file and injected line of code is removed, with the site fully functional and reachable. • A Web Application Firewall is in place, properly tuned for WordPress traffic. • Server settings are hardened: correct file permissions, disabled risky PHP functions, sensible rate limits, automatic core/plugin updates, and secure backups. • Ongoing monitoring reports suspicious activity to my email. • A brief hand-off document explains what was fixed, which rules were applied, and any routine tasks I should perform.
SSH/cPanel credentials and the latest backup will be ready the moment we start. If you have a solid track record cleaning hacked WordPress sites and tightening server security, I’m ready to move quickly.

item.title: Corporate Wellness Meal Portal
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m building an online hub that starts with a public-facing landing page and then moves into a secure member portal for employees. The core of the site is the meal-ordering system—everything else supports that experience.
Here is the end-to-end flow I need developed:
• A company enrolls through me. • I email its employees a unique link to create their login. • On first sign-in they complete an intake questionnaire (I’ll supply the exact questions later). • After submitting the questionnaire, they land on the ordering dashboard driven by a credit system. • Employees can spend weekly credits, top up with extra paid meals, or opt out for a day/week. • Orders must be locked in by each Friday; otherwise the system assigns three default meals. • Unused credits roll forward only one additional week before expiring. • Deliveries take place Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, so the order cutoff logic must reflect that schedule. • Each user also has a profile page showing personalised macros, calorie targets, meal plan and workout plan.
Key functions to include — Credit system for meal purchases. — Option to buy additional meals beyond available credits. — Automatic default meals when the Friday deadline passes.
Technical choices are flexible; I simply need a clean, secure build that can scale as more companies enrol. Please structure the code so future questionnaires, credit rules or delivery windows can be adjusted without a full rewrite.
Acceptance criteria 1. A guest landing page and a gated member portal. 2. Seamless sign-up flow from emailed link through questionnaire to dashboard. 3. Fully working credit logic, default-meal fallback and rollover cap. 4. Mobile-friendly interface and admin area where I can manage companies, credits and menus. 5. Deployment to my hosting with clear hand-over documentation.
If you have relevant examples—especially subscription or credit-based ordering tools—let me see them. I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right developer.

item.title: WordPress Development & SEO Expert Needed
item.description:
250-750 USD | SEO & WEBSITE DEVELOPER (WordPress) — Remote, Monthly Pay
About Us Our Company helps entrepreneurs start and grow their businesses. Our wordpress website is our storefront, and organic search is a core growth channel. We are hiring one person to own both: keep our WordPress site running perfectly and grow qualified organic traffic that turns into leads, sign-ups, and customers.
Starting Pay $300 USD per month, paid monthly. Pay is earned by completing the listed tasks and metrics on a signed weekly checklist, released after a 4-week+ review, paid upon completion of KPI metrics.
Schedule Flexible remote, fixed hours workday with a 30-minute lunch. Daily short written update to Admin; weekly report every Friday.
What You Will Do
Website Developer (WordPress site health) - Keep every page working perfectly on mobile, tablet, and desktop: no broken layouts, menus, images, links, or forms. - Test login, sign-up, password reset, order buttons, checkout, and all forms end to end. - Keep page speed under 3 seconds and Core Web Vitals green. - Run plugin, theme, and WordPress core updates on staging first, with a current backup, then apply live. - Fix issues the same day or escalate with a screenshot and page URL. - Weekly cross-browser check (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge).
SEO & Organic Growth - Publish 100 SEO-optimized templated pages per month (25 per week) through our page generator, using our master template. Upkeep and edit master templates as needed. - Do keyword research: long-tail, intent-driven, clustered, one primary keyword per page. - Earn 100 quality backlinks per month (DR 30–50+) through manual outreach. No PBNs, link farms, spam directories, or paid link networks. Paid placements require written approval in advance. - Technical SEO: keep Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog warnings at zero. Fix redirects, 404s, indexing, schema, and speed issues. - Conversion engineering: every page has a clear value proposition, benefit-driven H1, primary call to action, trust elements, and verified event tracking. - First 30 days: establish a documented baseline for organic sessions, leads, registrations, purchases, and conversion rate, and propose weekly/monthly growth targets for approval. Then report baseline vs. target vs. actual every Friday.
Member Website Publishing - Own customer website publishing requests from intake to completion: connect domains, verify DNS and SSL, publish the site, test layouts/forms/links, and confirm completion with the customer. - Set up staging builds and handle customer DNS updates. - Occasional quick WordPress pages or micro-sites using native Gutenberg blocks.
Tools You Will Use WordPress, Rank Math, Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and our internal SEO dashboard (keyword pipeline, page generator, rank tracker).
Requirements - Proven WordPress experience: themes, plugins, staging, backups, troubleshooting. - Working SEO knowledge: on-page, technical, keyword research, and manual link outreach. - Comfortable in Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog. - Gutenberg block editor experience (no third-party page builders). - Strong written English for daily and weekly reports. - Reliable internet and consistent daily availability. - You own routine fixes yourself and escalate only access, budget, security, or major platform decisions — with evidence and a recommended next step.
How We Measure Success (KPIs) - 100 new quality-checked SEO pages per month - 100 audited quality backlinks per month - Site load under 3 seconds; zero open technical warnings at week end - Weekly acquisition report every Friday; keyword report every Monday - Zero broken pages, forms, or layouts left open past 24 hours - Organic sessions, leads, registrations, and purchases growing against the approved baseline
How To Apply Send: (1) a short intro, (2) links to 2–3 WordPress sites you have managed or built, (3) one example of SEO results you produced (traffic, rankings, or links — with dates), and (4) your expected monthly rate. Applicants who complete a short paid test task move to the front.

item.title: Corporate WordPress Redesign & Development
item.description:
1500-3000 AUD | Our current WordPress site works, but it no longer reflects the polished, corporate image we project everywhere else. I want to give it a fresh, modern look and feel while keeping the content structure intact.
Scope of the makeover The visual language should be clean, professional, and consistent with a corporate brand— user experience should always be the priority. The existing website is quite large with a lot of existing pages and blog content, we are wanting to limit the impact on our existing SEO as much as possible so internal linking etc needs to remain unchanged.
Key areas to tackle • Homepage layout – a hero section that communicates our value proposition instantly, clearer content blocks, and stronger calls-to-action. • Navigation menu – simplified information architecture, drop-downs that work seamlessly on desktop and mobile, and sticky behaviour only if it enhances usability. • Footer design – well-organised links, concise contact details, social icons, and legal notices without clutter.
Technical expectations The build must stay within WordPress, using either a lightweight premium theme or a custom child theme approach. Core Web Vitals should remain healthy after the redesign. Re-using existing plugins is fine as long as load speed and security are not compromised. Please ensure full responsiveness, cross-browser compatibility, and accessibility best practices (WCAG 2.1 AA).
Hosting current already in place however, I am open to subscription services like 10web etc.
Deliverables 1. High-fidelity mock-ups for homepage, navigation states, and footer. 2. Fully developed WordPress pages implemented on a staging environment. 3. Final migration to the live server after my sign-off, including a short hand-over guide.
Acceptance criteria • Visual style aligns with the agreed corporate mood board. • All page templates render flawlessly on the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and mobile browsers. • Google PageSpeed Insights scores remain within the “Good” range post-launch. • No broken links or console errors in the inspector.
Timeline is flexible within reason, but I would like to see first concepts within one week of project start. If you have similar corporate redesigns in your portfolio, please link them when you message me so I can gauge style compatibility.

item.title: AI Agent for Website Development & Management
item.description:
30-250 USD | Hi,
I’m planning to build a nationwide Nail Salon Directory website, and I want to use an AI Agent to handle website development and management.
I will purchase a domain and hosting account with cPanel, public_html, PHP, and MySQL.
What I need is your help setting up an AI coding agent on my personal laptop that can securely connect directly to my hosting server and MySQL database.
My goal is to control the AI Agent using simple English instructions. For example, I want to tell it:
* Create or modify PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files. * Build new website pages and features. * Create, update, and manage MySQL tables. * Import and update nail salon directory data. * Fix errors and troubleshoot website problems. * Improve website design and SEO. * Test changes and deploy approved updates to the live website.
I want the AI Agent to be able to read and understand my existing website code and database structure, perform development tasks, and report the results back to me.
What I need you to help me set up:
1. Install and configure an AI coding agent on my laptop, such as OpenAI Codex or Claude Code. 2. Connect the agent securely to my hosting account using SSH/SFTP. 3. Configure controlled access to public_html and MySQL. 4. Set up Git, automatic backups, and rollback protection. 5. Create a staging environment so the AI can test changes before deploying them. 6. Configure permissions so important production changes require my approval. 7. Teach me how to operate the entire system independently.
My main objective is not to hire someone to build the Nail Salon Directory manually.
I want to build an AI-powered development environment that I can control from my laptop. Once everything is connected, I want to give the AI Agent instructions and have it perform the technical work.
Eventually, I also want to use the same setup to manage my other websites.
Please let me know:
* Have you set up a similar AI Agent system before? * Which AI Agent and tools would you recommend? * Can you help me install, connect, configure, and test everything? * How much would you charge for the complete setup?
I would like to start with one website as a test before connecting my other websites.
Thank you!
